2608.22140.title: Lexical Perturbations Disrupt LLM Reasoning: An Empirical Study of Attention Diversion
2608.22140.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, but their robustness to realistic lexical corruption remains poorly understood. We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models and frontier models across four reasoning benchmarks under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. Character-level perturbations substantially degrade accuracy, especially on multi-step reasoning tasks, while filler insertion has little effect. We trace this asymmetry to Attention Diversion: lexical corruption fragments subword tokenization, and the resulting fragments attract disproportionate attention mass, concentrated in middle and final transformer layers. Length-matched controls confirm that fragmentation, not prompt length, drives the loss. A factorial intervention then shows why the damage is hard to undo: fragmentation corrupts token content and attention allocation together, and the two are coupled. Restoring clean attention while the content remains corrupted is actively harmful, restoring content alone is insufficient, and only restoring both recovers a substantial share of the gap. This coupling explains why inference-time strategies, including chain-of-thought prompting, spell-checking, self-repair, and stronger repair models, fail to consistently recover performance: each addresses one channel at a time. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Jiaqian-Janelle/Attention-Diversion
2608.22140.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在推理表現上表現出色，但它們對現實語彙損壞的穩健性仍然不甚了解。<lb/>我們評估了四個開放權重的指令調整模型和前沿模型，在鍵盤噪音、字符交換和填充插入的四個推理基準上進行測試。<lb/>字符級擾動顯著降低了準確性，尤其是在多步推理任務中，而填充插入的影響微乎其微。<lb/>我們將這種不對稱性追溯到注意力轉移：語彙損壞使子詞標記化破碎，隨之而來的碎片吸引了不成比例的注意力質量，集中在中間和最終的Transformer層。<lb/>長度匹配的對照實驗確認了破碎性，而非提示長度，驅動了損失。<lb/>一項因子干預顯示為何損害難以恢復：破碎性同時損壞了標記內容和注意力分配，兩者是耦合的。<lb/>在內容仍然損壞的情況下恢復乾淨的注意力是有害的，僅恢復內容是不夠的，只有同時恢復兩者才能彌補相當一部分的差距。<lb/>這種耦合解釋了為何推理時策略，包括思維鏈提示、拼寫檢查、自我修復和更強的修復模型，無法穩定地恢復性能：每個策略一次只處理一個通道。<lb/>代碼和數據可在 https://github.com/Jiaqian-Janelle/Attention-Diversion 獲得。
